purpose: Detect candidate questions and missing epistemic surfaces that have not yet become formulated TOKEN_VAZIO gaps.

detectors_v1.question: Which critical evidence/governance surface is absent from the bounded asset and gap views?
Which existing asset category has not yet been explicitly interrogated in the bounded Gap Atlas view?
Which known gap lacks a condition capable of falsifying its framing?
Which known gap has no smallest verifiable uncertainty-reducing action?

acceptance_gates: no candidate is automatically promoted to TOKEN_VAZIO
candidate identifiers are stable for identical detector class and key

omega7_projection.how_do_we_know: Deterministic bounded scan plus test/CI receipts
omega7_projection.how_it_works: Compare observed asset/gap surfaces against explicit epistemic interrogation rules
omega7_projection.falsifier: A candidate is emitted as fact, or identical bounded inputs produce unstable candidate IDs/content
omega7_projection.provenance: Git branch/commit + input paths + CI run
omega7_projection.next_experiment: Run on current Mapa inputs, review candidates, then promote only confirmed formulated gaps

cognitive_cycle.chi: observation: bounded inventory and gap records
cognitive_cycle.rho: noise: absence, aliases, naming mismatch, incomplete coverage
cognitive_cycle.delta: transformation: candidate with explicit epistemic boundary
cognitive_cycle.omega: completion: only after a verifiable probe resolves or formalizes the gap

r3.f_ok: Executable detector, deterministic candidate model and tests are defined.
r3.f_gap: Current real-input execution receipt is pending until CI/runner executes the branch.
r3.f_next: Execute the branch gate; inspect real candidates; append only evidence-backed TOKEN_VAZIO promotions.
